risks.risk: The camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, LCD screen damage, or lens issues).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the LCD screen.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front element, under bright light to reveal scratches or haze.

risks.risk: The camera may have a high shutter count or be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a diagnostic tool or a photo taken with the camera showing the shutter count in the menu.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera's screen showing the model name (e.g., D60).
Video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the LCD screen.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for scratches or haze.
